Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Beasley
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/05/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 45 as introduced allows the Secretary of State to conduct a post-election audit of the November 8, 2022 election in three counties, which could increase the obligations of the Secretary of State and the judges of probate and sheriffs of these select counties by an estimated maximum of $30,000 collectively according to the Secretary of State. However, this bill provides that the expenses of these local offices would be reimbursed from federal funds. According to the Secretary of State, the local offices and the Secretary's office would be reimbursed from Help America Vote Act funds.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
